meta.title: How {{brand.name}} works | From the first booking to the next one
meta.description: Your page, bookings and payments, messages, the door, the night itself and the follow-up, in one app for hosts. Use all of it, or start with one part.
meta.socialDescription: One app, from the first booking to the next one. See how {{brand.name}} runs the whole life of an event.

sections.title: One app, from the first booking to the next one.
sections.lead: {{brand.name}} runs the whole life of an event: your page, bookings and payments, the door, the night itself and the follow-up. Use all of it, or start with one part.

items.title: Your page
items.body: A page that replaces the link in your bio.

items.title: Bookings and payments
items.body: Applications, waitlists, and UPI or card.

items.title: Messages
items.body: Confirmations, reminders and updates for everyone booked.

items.title: The door
items.body: QR or self check-in on a phone or iPad.

items.title: The night
items.body: Groups, teams, seating and rotations, by format.

items.title: After
items.body: Reviews, reports, payouts and who to invite back.

sections.title: Get found, fill it, and tell people where to be.

groups.title: Your page
list: Your links, upcoming events and reviews in one place, for your Instagram bio
Events you run elsewhere appear as tiles that link out
Reviews from people who booked, with your replies, and followers you can tell about your next event
It may already exist: claim it free

groups.title: Bookings and payments
list: Applications with the questions you ask, approved with a tap
Waitlists, with offers that stay open for as long as you choose
Private offers and invite-only events
Up to four places on one booking, with a name for each guest
UPI or card, every payment next to the right name, refunds by your policy

groups.title: Messages
list: Confirmations and changes for everyone booked, and a push reminder 15 minutes before the start for guests on the {{brand.name}} app
Announcements to everyone booked, and WhatsApp campaigns from your own WhatsApp Business number

sections.title: Open the door, then run the room.

groups.title: The door
list: QR or self check-in, on your phone or an iPad at the door
Arrivals, late-comers and walk-ins, live
Check-ins made without signal sync when you’re back online

groups.title: The night
list: Pace groups, tables, teams, court rotations or a route between venues, built for each format
A first hello, and Help me say hi for private introductions
Guests join live moments in their phone’s browser, no app needed
A dress rehearsal with your team before doors open

sections.title: Know what worked, and who to invite back.

groups.title: After
list: One record per guest across every event you run
Reviews and private feedback, with replies
A report in {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} after every event, and insights across them
Payouts to your own Razorpay account, and roles for your team
Groups such as first-timers, regulars and lapsed regulars, so you know who to invite back

items.title: Forms
items.body: Build a form, share the link, and see answers next to each guest.

items.title: Links for promoters
items.body: A link for every promoter, venue and post, with its opens, bookings and check-ins.

items.title: Bring your list
items.body: Import guests from a CSV or Excel file. Nothing changes for them until the doors open.

items.title: Weddings and programmes
items.body: Guests, travel, rooms and run sheets for multi-day events.

sections.title: Hand {{brand.name}} as much of the evening as you want.

items.title: Keep your tools
items.body: Import your guest list and use {{brand.name}} for the door and the night. Nothing changes for guests until doors open.

items.title: Take bookings on {{brand.name}}
items.body: Applications, payments and reminders, with one record for every guest.

items.title: Get found on {{brand.name}}
items.body: Your events appear where people in your city look for something to do.

sections.title: See it on your next event.
sections.lead: Everything is included in the trial. Free events stay free after it.
